title: 第23章 不留活口第24章 信息探查饕餮神体
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
刷——
转瞬之间。
赵二就冲到江尘近前，手中匕首闪烁着寒光，朝着他胸口直刺而去。
另一边。
被抓住手臂的刘能也是神色一狠。
只见。
他体内真气极速运转，另一只手臂快速伸入自己怀里。
从中抽出了一柄碧绿色短剑。
刷——
随后。
刘能手持碧绿色短剑。
朝着江尘小腹位置刺去。
轰隆——
然而。
在这关键时刻，江尘周身竟突兀出现了一道气墙，将两人的攻击给挡了下来。
砰砰——
两人的匕首同时落在气墙上，任凭他们如何加大真气力度，都无法突破这个气墙。
赵二：“该死，这…这是罡气护体，他是神海境强者！”
惊叫一声后。

赵二快速向后方退去，此时他脸上充满了惊恐之色，更多的则是不可置信。
赵二是退回去了。
可刘能的手臂被江尘牢牢抓住，他一点反抗的机会也没有。
神海境？
萧云等人一听这话，瞬间就停下了自己的脚步，满眼不可思议的看向了江尘。
噗呲～
咳咳～
就在这时。
江尘一把夺过刘能手中的匕首，反手就刺入了他的胸口之中。
不一会。
刘能的身体就开始抽搐了起来，整个人更是口吐白沫，挣扎几下就没了动静。
很显然。
他的这把匕首上有剧毒。
白鸿飞：“死…死了？”
看着自己带来的人就这么死了，白鸿飞脸上终于露出了惊恐之色。

………………
Brush——
In the blink of an eye.
Zhao Er rushed to Jiang Chen, the dagger in his hand flashed with cold light, and stabbed straight into his chest.
other side.
Liu Neng, whose arm was grabbed, also looked grim.
I saw.
The true energy in his body was moving rapidly, and his other arm quickly reached into his arms.
A green dagger was drawn from it.
Brush——
Subsequently.
Liu Neng is holding a green dagger.
Stab towards Jiang Chen's lower abdomen.
Boom——
However.
At this critical moment, a wall of air suddenly appeared around Jiang Chen, blocking the attacks of the two men.
Bang bang——
The two men's daggers landed on the Qi wall at the same time. No matter how hard they increased their Qi, they could not break through the Qi wall.
Zhao Er: "Damn it, this... this is the Gang Qi body protection, he is a strong man in the Divine Sea Realm!"
After screaming.
Zhao Er quickly retreated back. At this time, his face was full of horror, and more of it was disbelief.
Zhao Er went back.
But Liu Neng's arm was firmly grasped by Jiang Chen, and he had no chance to resist.
Divine Sea Realm?
When Xiao Yun and others heard this, they immediately stopped in their tracks and looked at Jiang Chen in disbelief.
Phew~
Ahem~
Just then.
Jiang Chen snatched the dagger from Liu Neng's hand and stabbed it into his chest with his backhand.
Not a moment.
Liu Neng's body began to twitch, and he was foaming at the mouth. After struggling for a few times, there was no movement.
Obviously.
This dagger of his has poison on it.
Bai Hongfei: "Dead...dead?"
Seeing that the people he brought died like this, Bai Hongfei finally showed a look of horror on his face.
